messages:
sara (AE): SprintBank wants a clear POC capacity plan: baseline 150 RPS, spikes to 520 RPS for ~15m, avg request ~3.5k tokens. They asked for reserved vs burst cost, VPC peering, and CMK. Need a short recommendation we can send today.
diego (Solutions): Quick calc: 520 * 3.5k ≈ 1.82M tokens/sec peak. With good batching and session KV reuse we usually get 3-4x effective reduction. Recommend primary: 13B q4 quantized; fallback: 7B high-throughput.
rachel (Infra): Proposed topology: Hosted Dedicated baseline pool = 8 x H100-80GB, autoscale up to 24 for bursts, prewarm 3 nodes. Min=8, Max=24, scale_up_step=4, cooldown=45s. For Private option same sizing but with VPC peering and CMK.
irma (SRE): SRE notes: enable KV preheat for top 250 sessions and sticky routing. Failure-mode: if prewarm/scale fails -> route to 7B pool (2 nodes) + enable truncation for long completions. Canary policy: 5% traffic, 20m observe, rollback on error rate >1.5% or p95 increase >25%.
kartik (Pricing): Ballpark: 8 reserved H100s ~ $AAAk/mo; bursting to 24 on-demand adds incremental infra hours. We can offer 10% off reserved if they commit 6 months and include 3 preheat credits/month for the POC. I'll draft two-line quote (Hosted Reserved vs Private).
sec-bot: Security: VPC peering supported; CMK supported for Private; audit logs available with 30d default retention (extendable). Recommend Private for regulated banking data.
diego (Solutions): Autoscale snippet to share with customer ops:```{ "min_gpus":8, "max_gpus":24, "scale_up_step":4, "scale_down_step":2, "cooldown_sec":45, "prewarm":3, "routing_policy":"latency_priority" }```
sara (AE): Action items: rachel/diego run perf sim at 8/16/24 GPUs with q4-13B and 7B fallback and post CSV; kartik send draft pricing; irma produce short runbook for preheat/fallback. I'll send SprintBank the two-option summary after we have perf numbers.
diego (Solutions): Scheduling perf now; will post p50/p95/p99 and kv_hit_ratio within 24h.
irma (SRE): I'll join the handoff call and provide chaos checklist (quota exhaustion, KV cold start, noisy neighbor).
sara (AE): Thanks team, target: send customer by tomorrow morning.
